title: Four Growers Uses AI to Harvest Tomatoes at Nature Fresh Farms
summary: In 2022, Nature Fresh partnered with Four Growers, a FANUC Authorized System Integrator, to develop a robotic system equipped with AI to harvest tomatoes in the greenhouse environment. Today, the automated system allows Nature Fresh to expand more rapidly and potentially cover double the acreage with their current staff.
